name: Andean Pachakuna
summary: Descendants of Inca priests who still perform rituals at the old temples. Their connection to Pachamama is unbroken.
lore: High in the Andes, the old gods never died — they simply went silent, waiting. The Pachakuna kept the fires burning at the sacred temples, speaking to the earth itself. The mountains remember everything.

events.title: The Fog of Chiloé
events.narrative: A supernatural fog rolls in from the Pacific, thicker than any natural mist. Your followers can barely see their hands.

choiceB.label: Light signal fires to guide the lost

events.title: The Jungle Speaks
events.narrative: The rainforest around your territory begins to whisper at night. The spirits of the trees are testing your resolve.

random.winMessage: The spirits submit to your will. +15% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The jungle rejects your arrogance. Four followers are lost in the night. -4 Followers.

events.title: The Lost Temple
events.narrative: Scouts discover an overgrown temple deep in the jungle. The carvings on its walls still glow faintly.

choiceA.label: Study the carvings and absorb their power

events.title: The River Turns Red
events.narrative: The great river that feeds your territory turns blood-red for three days. The fish die. The people panic.

choiceB.label: Harvest the red water for potions

events.title: The Rival Shaman
events.narrative: A powerful shaman from a neighboring tribe challenges your spiritual authority before a council of elders.

choiceA.label: Accept the spiritual duel
choiceA.description: +30% Faith if you win, -5 Followers if you lose

random.winMessage: Your magic overwhelms the shaman. The council bows to you. +30% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The shaman's ancient craft is stronger. Five followers defect. -5 Followers.

events.title: The Jaguar Spirit
events.narrative: A massive black jaguar appears at the edge of your territory. It sits and watches with intelligent eyes for three nights.

random.winMessage: You bind the jaguar's spirit! Its power courses through your coven. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The jaguar spirit is too powerful. Six followers are mauled. -6 Followers.

events.title: The Flood Season
events.narrative: The seasonal floods rise higher than any in living memory. Your lowland shrines are threatened.

events.title: The Cursed Idol
events.narrative: A farmer plows up a golden idol with obsidian eyes. Everyone who touches it begins to dream of drowning.

choiceA.label: Bind the idol's spirit to your coven

choiceB.label: Bury it deep and ward the site

events.title: The Ancestor Council
events.narrative: The spirits of a thousand generations gather in your dreams, demanding to know why you disturb their rest.

choiceA.label: Plead your case and offer tribute

random.winMessage: The ancestors acknowledge your strength. +15% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The ancestors curse your arrogance. Five followers sicken. -5 Followers.

events.title: The Solar Eclipse
events.narrative: A total eclipse darkens your territory. The old texts say this is the moment of greatest power.
